items.title: Axon (NASDAQ:AXON) reports sales below analyst estimates in Q3 2026 earnings, stock drops 18.4%
items.summary: Self-defense company AXON (NASDAQ:AXON) fell short of the market’s revenue expectations in Q3 2026, but revenue rose 27.8% year on year to $908.6 million. Next quarter’s revenue guidance of $1 billion underwhelmed, coming in 6.8% below analysts’ consensus estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $1.72 per share was 9% below analysts’ consensus estimates.

items.title: Axon: Q3 Earnings Snapshot
items.summary: (AXON) on Thursday reported third-quarter net income of $57 million, after reporting a loss in the same period a year earlier.The Scottsdale, Arizona-based company said it had profit of 68 cents per share.

items.title: AppLovin earnings analysis: questions answered and next catalysts
items.summary: Investing.com -- AppLovin Corp (APP) reported Q3 on Nov 4, 2026, and the stock is up about 28% at $347.73 (as of Nov 5, 1:14 PM EST). That reaction is the reverse of the -20.02% and -22.42% moves after the Q2 and Q4 FY2025 prints. Even with the jump, the stock is still down about 49% YTD and well below its 52-week high of $738.01.
